arguments.sql:
SELECT e."Diagnosis",
       COUNT(*) AS exam_count,
       SUM(e."Symptoms" IS NULL) AS null_symptoms,
       SUM(e."Symptoms" IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(e."Symptoms", CHAR(9,10,13,32)) = '') AS blank_symptoms,
       SUM(TRIM(e."Symptoms") = '-') AS dash_symptoms,
       SUM(p."Birthday" IS NULL) AS null_birthdays,
       MIN(p."Birthday") AS earliest_birth,
       MAX(p."Birthday") AS latest_birth
FROM "Examination" AS e
JOIN "Patient" AS p ON p."ID" = e."ID"
WHERE e."Diagnosis" LIKE '%SLE%'
GROUP BY e."Diagnosis"
ORDER BY exam_count DESC, e."Diagnosis"

arguments.sql:
SELECT e."Symptoms", p."Diagnosis"
FROM "Examination" AS e
JOIN "Patient" AS p ON p."ID" = e."ID"
WHERE TRIM(e."Symptoms", CHAR(9, 10, 13, 32)) <> ''
  AND p."Birthday" IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    WITH RECURSIVE disease_list(remaining) AS (
      SELECT REPLACE(e."Diagnosis", '+', ',') || ','
      UNION ALL
      SELECT SUBSTR(remaining, INSTR(remaining, ',') + 1)
      FROM disease_list
      WHERE remaining <> ''
    )
    SELECT 1
    FROM disease_list
    WHERE TRIM(
      SUBSTR(remaining, 1, INSTR(remaining, ',') - 1),
      CHAR(9, 10, 13, 32)
    ) = 'SLE'
  )
ORDER BY p."Birthday" DESC, p."ID" ASC, e."Examination Date" DESC
LIMIT 1
